data.heading: A made-up count: who lived here
data.date_line: A made-up count, dated 21 March 2021. Nothing here was counted, and nobody published it.
notes: In a real count, this note says what was unusual about the day it was taken.
An area can change, so these figures describe it on that day, and not as it is today.
Burro draws Grapnel Dock from 1 made-up small area, and the figures are made-up counts, which Burro has added up.
Shares are whole numbers and may not add up to 100%. Where fewer than 1 in 100 were counted, the table says so and gives no count.
Beside each figure you will see the figure for Quillhaven as a whole, and nothing else. Burro does not say what any figure means.
